Maggie Chen: Ok team — planning checklist for next week's 'Sprout' launch. Goal: +15% 7-day activated users via free credits + onboarding prompt templates + a short webinar. Quick sync? Notion plan: https://notion.so/sprout-launch :spiral_calendar:
Ashok Patel: Love it. Are we running 3 nudge variants or 4? small sample sizes will matter.
Jordan Lee: 3 variants + control. Friendly nudge, technical nudge, product-led demo nudge.
Tia Gomez: Can we gate the credits on completing the quickstart (first run of a prompt)? That should improve retention vs handing credits upfront.
Maggie Chen: Agreed — gate credits after quickstart completion. Samir, can you wire the credit webhook & cohort tagging?
Samir Rao: On it. ETA EOD today. Quick snippet I'll use:
```
POST /api/credits/issue
{
  "user_id": "<id>",
  "cohort": "sprout_onboard_v1",
  "amount": 50
}
```
product-bot: Reminder: webinar registration opens in 48 hours — auto emails scheduled.
Eva Alvarez: Webinar format: 15m live demo (show benchmarks), 10m quickstart walkthrough (use prompt templates), 20m Q&A. Need two benchmark slides: latency and cost per 1k tokens vs baseline.
Ashok Patel: I'll draft 3 onboarding prompt templates: "support reply", "summarize long thread", "code-fix assistant". Will keep examples <= 3 turns so users can try immediately.
Maggie Chen: Experiment config (for tracking/analytics):
```
experiment: sprout_nudge_v1
variants: [control, friendly, technical, product]
metric_primary: activation_7d
metric_secondary: usage_14d, retention_30d
rollout_pct: 100
cohort_tag: sprout_onboard_v1
```
Tia Gomez: Inbound routing: tag webinar signups with `sprout-webinar` and route to SDR queue A (timezone split). I'll add routing rules in HubSpot and send the playbook.
Jordan Lee: Quick ask — can we add a small benchmark narrative blurb for marketing copy? 1–2 lines: "Sprout reduces inference latency by X ms and cuts token costs by Y% on typical generation workloads." Eva, can you supply numbers after you run the perf sweep?
Eva Alvarez: Yep — running perf sweep tonight, will post numbers and a short blurb by tomorrow morning.
Maggie Chen: Nice. Action items: Samir (webhook + tagging), Ashok (templates), Eva (benchmarks & blurb), Tia (routing + playbook), Jordan & I (webinar script + slides). 11am tomorrow final run-through? :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: 11am works for me. :party:
Samir Rao: Confirmed. I'll also add a lightweight smoke test for credit issuance.
Tia Gomez: I'll export routing rules and post the HubSpot playbook link in the thread.
Maggie Chen: Awesome — thanks everyone. Will update the Notion with the final matrix after the 11am review.
